tips.title: Assembling Multi-Part Gun Barrels: Trumpeter vs AFV Club
tips.text: For Trumpeter kits, attach the smallest barrel section first using Tamiya Extra Thin Cement, then align and glue subsequent sections with tweezers. For AFV Club kits, insert the smallest section into the largest, apply cement, and twist gently until aligned. Use accelerator (e.g., Tamiya Time Accelerator) for faster bonding.

tips.title: Jig for Wing Alignment: ICM Spad VII
tips.text: When assembling ICM's Spad VII wings, cut a rectangular hole in a thin cardboard sheet, aligning it with the wing's dihedral angle. Insert the wings into the hole, ensuring they meet flush. Apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement along the join, clamping gently with a small wooden block. Let cure overnight.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: Before bending Eduard PE parts, score the bend line with a sharp blade. Use Eduard's PE bending tool at 90° to 120° pressure, applying consistent force. For complex bends, anneal parts in a pan of boiling water for 10 minutes, then bend. After installation, attach PE with CA glue, reinforcing from the underside with small drops of super glue.

tips.title: Working with Resin Conversion Kits: Clear Prop Models
tips.text: Clean Clear Prop Models resin parts with soap and water, allowing them to air-dry. Remove any excess resin with a sharp blade. Assemble parts using CA glue (e.g., Tamiya Extra Thin CA), applying drops on the mating surfaces. Use tweezers for alignment, letting parts cure for 30 seconds before handling.

tips.title: Assembling Tracks: Individual Link vs Vinyl vs Workable
tips.text: For individual link tracks (e.g., Meng /85), use tweezers to align and glue links with Tamiya Extra Thin Cement. For vinyl tracks, soak in warm water for 30 seconds, then carefully stretch and glue with CA glue. For workable tracks, carefully bend links to fit, gluing with CA glue. Always dry-fit before gluing to ensure proper alignment.
